archetypes.name: dyn-conflict-routing
archetypes.rationale: Phase 2 and Phase 3 routing now decide whether ship-pr conflict reviews actually run.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on skills/implement/references/conflict-resolution.md. Verify early_rebase still skips Phase 3, ship_pr_pre_push reaches Phase 3 for non-trivial conflict resolutions, and trivial-all conflicts still skip the panel. Check that the template fragment load is reachable only on the intended Phase 3 path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-generator-registry
archetypes.rationale: The new generated artifact depends on both CLI registries and generator drift checks staying aligned.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new conflict-resolution-code-reviewer generator, python/larch/cli.py dispatch row, scripts/generators.tsv registration, and generated output. Confirm the generator copies heading-bounded source sections without using agent rendering helpers and that committed output will pass generator checks after staging. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
